name: @windower/sidecar-macos
description: Swift Package wrapper so turbo can drive swift build/swift test for the macOS capture + control sidecar binaries.

scripts.codesign: if [ -z "$DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION" ]; then echo 'skip: DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION not set, skipping codesign/notarize (see CODESIGNING.md)'; else ./scripts/codesign-notarize.sh .build/release/windower-capture-macos && ./scripts/codesign-notarize.sh .build/release/windower-control-macos; fi
